name: Nuts - A Dark Romance Game
source:
On a day like any other, a shift occurred! Woodland forest inhabitants have become sentient, and the traditional circle of life has been thrown off balance. Woodland animals (like owls and squirrels) and even nuts (hazelnuts, chestnuts, etc.) can think, walk, and talk! The government created a network of biospheres to observe these new sentient, intelligent lifeforms and better understand this phenomenon.

The story follows Hazel (re-nameable), a humble hazelnut. She’s a farmer who enjoys all things nature, but especially loves bird watching, gardening, fishing, and organic local produce. As the main contestant on the Woodland Forest Dating Show, she can choose from 4 available, nutty suitors!

Isn't this all just… nuts?!

[From [url=https://lilalove.itch.io/nuts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
和往常一样的一天，转变发生了！林地森林居民变得有知觉，传统的生活圈失去了平衡。林地动物（如猫头鹰和松鼠）甚至坚果（榛子、栗子等）都可以思考、行走和说话！政府创建了一个生物圈网络来观察这些新的有感知、智慧的生命形式并更好地理解这一现象。

故事讲述的是榛子（Hazel，可重命名），一种不起眼的榛子。她是一位热爱大自然的农民，特别喜欢观鸟、园艺、钓鱼和当地有机农产品。作为Woodland Forest约会秀的主要参赛者，她可以从4名疯狂的追求者中进行选择！

这一切是不是……很疯狂？！

[来自[url=https://lilalove.itch.io/nuts]itch.io[/url]]
